item.title: CarTube v1.3
item.description:
CarTube 1.3 | CarTube
Big Fixes + Some Features Update! - Much smoother experience - Swipe left or right anywhere on the screen to go Back or Forward - Native m.youtube.com player, so ALL videos should work plus comments and playlists, and should be all around smoother - New "Play on CarPlay" share extension, works with YouTube app - Zoom in settings works better and scales content correctly - Added age restriction bypass - Added ad blocker (beta) - Fixed awful scrolling - Fixed Google signin page zoom - Fixed the buggy keyboard bar - Small fixes to the persistence helper, Siri no longer breaks it
